as_told.title: Leaked Kit Green / Kit Randall May phone call about testing experiencers and 'hybrids'

plain: A leaked phone call between two men, Kit Green and K. Randall May, is said to show them talking about testing people who have had contact experiences. Dylan Borland, a guest who says a top official confided in him, says that in the call they talk about "testing veterans, military, government officials who have had experiences", and that they call these people "hybrids" in their own words. He dates it to 2017. He also brings up the famous psychic Uri Geller. Matthew Brown, who describes himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, also mentions the leaked call between Green and May, but only in passing. If true, it would suggest that people inside government quietly study those who say they have had contact.
